pair.noDimmersFound: No dimmers found. The app supports only the first generation (@ND), not SG Smart 3.0. Close the SG Smart app on your phone and try again closer to a dimmer. If that does not help, send a diagnostics report right away: Settings, Apps, SG LEDDim.
pair.allAlreadyAdded: All the dimmers found have already been added.

members.title: Dimmers in this group
members.hint: Tick the dimmers this group should drive. They must already be added as dimmers in Homey.
members.none: No dimmers have been added yet. Add your dimmers first, then add a group.

keepConnected.label: Keep dimmers connected
keepConnected.hint: Faster control, and wall switch changes show up right away. With only one dimmer, the SG app can't connect at the same time.

signal.title: Signal to Homey
signal.hint: Only the dimmer showing "Direct" needs a good signal. If it is weak, move Homey closer to one of the dimmers.

otherDevice.title: Other SG devices
otherDevice.hint: Have another SG device named @NDxxxx? Try to add it and use it a little. Then right away press "Create diagnostics report" on the app page, below Configure.

device.notHeard: No status from the dimmer. Wrong password, or out of range?

settings.title: SG Smart 3.0
settings.intro: Only for SG Smart 3.0. The older dimmers above do not need this.
settings.how: How do you want to connect?
settings.useApp: Use the network from the SG app
settings.ownNetwork: Let Homey make its own network (coming later)
settings.keysHint: 32 hex digits each. The keys give full control of the lights. Do not share them.
settings.jsonHint: Paste the whole export, or choose the file.
settings.removeConfirm: Remove the network from Homey? The keys are deleted here. The SG app and the lights are not affected.
settings.imported: The network is imported. Add the dimmers under Devices.

errors.invalid_json: The pasted text is not valid JSON: __detail__. Paste the full contents of the exported file; a partial or word-wrapped copy will not parse.
errors.invalid_export: The pasted text is not a valid network export: __detail__. Paste the full contents of the exported file.
errors.invalid_net_key: The network key must be 32 hex digits.
errors.invalid_app_key: The app key must be 32 hex digits.
errors.other_network: This is a different network (Network ID __detail__). Remove the network first.
errors.devices_left: First remove the SG Smart 3.0 dimmers from Homey (__detail__).
errors.address_taken: A node already uses that address.
errors.not_configured: SG Smart 3.0 is not set up.
